## Installation

<docs.Tabs sync="install">
<docs.TabItem label="CLI">

Run the command in the app module.

```sh frame="terminal" title="Terminal"
gx add data-table-page
```

The command also installs [`card`](/components/card/) and [`input`](/components/input/).

The command writes these files.

| File | Path in the app |
| --- | --- |
| `DataTablePage.gx` | `ui/data-table-page/DataTablePage.gx` |
| `DataTablePage.fixtures.go` | `ui/data-table-page/DataTablePage.fixtures.go` |

</docs.TabItem>
<docs.TabItem label="Manual">

Install [`card`](/components/card/) and [`input`](/components/input/) first.

Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/data-table-page/DataTablePage.gx"
package datatablepage

import (
	"github.com/alternayte/gx/registry/card"
	"github.com/alternayte/gx/registry/input"
)

props {
  Title       string
  Description string   = ""
  Filter      gx.Node  = nil
  Table       gx.Node
  Pagination  gx.Node  = nil
}

<div class="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6">
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <h1 class="text-xl font-semibold">{p.Title}</h1>
      if p.Description != "" {
        <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{p.Description}</p>
      }
    </div>
    if p.Filter != nil {
      <div class="w-56">
        {p.Filter}
      </div>
    }
  </div>
  <card.Card>
    {p.Table}
  </card.Card>
  if p.Pagination != nil {
    <div class="flex justify-center">{p.Pagination}</div>
  }
</div>
```

```go title="ui/data-table-page/DataTablePage.fixtures.go"
package datatablepage

import "github.com/alternayte/gx"

var DataTablePageFixtures = gx.Fixtures[DataTablePageProps]{
	"Default": {
		Title:       "Invoices",
		Description: "Every invoice for this workspace.",
		Filter:      gx.Text("Search"),
		Table:       gx.Text("Table slot"),
		Pagination:  gx.Text("Pagination slot"),
	},
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

The theme must define these tokens: `--border`, `--card`, `--card-foreground`, `--muted-foreground`.

## Usage

```gx
<datatablepage.DataTablePage title="Invoices" filter={filterInput} table={table} pagination={paging} />
```

The block is copied source. The table and the paging links come from the app, so the sort, filter and page state stay typed in Go.

<Example item="data-table-page" name="data-table-page-default" label="Data Table Page: Default" block>

```gx
<datatablepage.DataTablePage title="Invoices" description="Every invoice for this workspace.">
```

</Example>

## Do and don't

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Put the filter in the header row.
- Keep the table in one card.

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not page on the client.
- Do not render more rows than the page size.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves to the filter, then the table links, then the paging links. |
| Enter | Follows the focused sort or page link. |
